title: fitc4 configuration
description: Paths are resolved relative to this file. Provider arrays are available in the fitc4.config.ts/.js module forms; the JSON form carries only these fields.

version.description: Config format version. An unknown version is an error, not a silent default.

repositoryRoot.description: Repository root, relative to this file. Every reported path is relative to it.

scanRoots.description: Repository-relative directories under architecture control. A missing, misspelled, or source-free root is an error rather than an empty pass; an empty string would put the entire repository under scan and is rejected.

tsconfig.description: tsconfig supplying compiler options (paths, baseUrl) for module resolution. The file must exist — point this at your project's real tsconfig.
